steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I can't believe she bought all that nonsense of yours and is fighting like a person being possessed! Is she stupid for real or just faking it?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Stay alert. We haven't seen her true colors yet.
Horo shrugs the remains off her shoulders, throws down her ax, which sinks into the ground, and turns to face you.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Sorry. You came to help, but all you got was a beating from me. I've brought discredit on the Legion.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Hit me, throw punches at me, as many as you like, until you have vented your anger.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ${PlayerName}, our little friend here is asking you to hit her. Can you bring yourself to do that? Want me to do the honors?

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Don't hold back! I am a Legion warrior who can hold her own, not some useless kid who hides behind someone else!

options: Clearing up the misunderstanding is enough. We have other business to attend to.
We can settle the score when we're back. One hundred punches won't be enough.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: That's very magnanimous of you. I get what my boss sees in you. Now, take me to see her.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: It's a deal! Now, take me to see her.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I meant to stay here, get rid of anyone coming here for the inheritance, and wait until my boss arrived.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: But things have changed. Boss Zoya needs me now, I must be there.
...Of course you're not saying yes. You should stay away from Zoya as best you can, find the inheritance before her, and then leave.

options: That won't work. We should deal with the inheritance first.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Traps like that mean nothing to Zoya. The real risk is the inheritance; it would speed up the deterioration of the situation.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: Are you asking me to turn my back on my boss?!

options: You would only be holding her back.
You need to have faith in her.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's obvious that you're not recovered yet. Protecting yourself and taking care of the inheritance is what you can do for Zoya now.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I'm not that useless! I still can fight. Please, let me go and help my boss... Mmm...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Protecting you and taking care of the inheritance are what Earl paid us to do. Zoya can handle her end, and she'll meet up with us by the side of the inheritance.

steps.speaker: Horo
steps.content: I... I don't need his meddling! I still can fight. Let me go and help the boss... Mmm...
She gets worked up and makes to take a step forward, but she stumbles and falls onto the ground, unable to pick herself up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I didn't know she's bleeding so profusely. Quick! Take her coat off.

You take care to remove the leather coat sticking to her body. Her tiny body is covered with wounds so deep that the bones are almost visible—new wounds that are oozing blood, mingled with old ones that have reopened.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: She did get first aid in the SALVA. She's indeed the Sinner hidden away by the SALVA.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: How long had she been fighting down there by herself? Are Legion people all lunatics?
That didn't seem like her way... Or is this part of her shifting strategies?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Should we put her under control with the shackles?

options: ...No, not for now. Let's carry her down. I've got something to ask her.
